title: Hydrogen adsorption and dissociation on AunY (n = 1–12) nanoclusters: a DFT investigation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24668-24678
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01901J, Paper

Nguyen Van Dang, Ngo Thi Lan, Nguyen Thi Mai, Son Tung Ngo, Phung Thi Thu, Nguyen Thanh Tung
Calculated reaction pathway and relative energies (in eV) for the dissociative adsorption of H2 on Au11Y. The transition and intermediates states are denoted as TSi and Ii. An activation energy of 0.63 eV is required for the dissociation process.
